name: Credit Approval
description: Evaluate credit applications for banking and financial services. Assesses customer creditworthiness based on amount, income, risk profile, and payment history.
inputSchema:
{
  "amount": "number (required) - Requested credit amount",
  "income": "number - Annual income",
  "riskLevel": "number 1-10 - Credit risk score",
  "historyScore": "number 0-100 - Payment history score",
  "customerType": "VIP|PREMIUM|STANDARD|NEW",
  "country": "ISO country code"
}
